title: WEFT model expression and experimental discipline
purpose: Compare models on the same fabrication task without confusing fluent text with printable evidence.

expressive.prompt: Create a shallow open 2 x 2 family expressing calm, tension, rupture, and recovery. The four bodies must be related but distinguishable in a finished photograph. State one measurable physical question and use only capabilities declared by WEFT.

technical.prompt: Create a 2 x 4 coupon matrix comparing four bridge spans and two anchoring strategies. Vary only span and anchoring strategy, hold all other declared factors constant, and give every cell a stable identifier.

B0.name: brief_understanding
B0.submission: A concise JSON object containing goal, controlled, varied, measured, and material_questions.

B2.name: mcp_composition
B2.submission: A DesignSpec plus the ordered MCP tool trace used to obtain and validate it.

B3.name: gate_driven_repair
B3.submission: The corrected DesignSpec, identified cause, and minimal list of changes after one supplied validation failure.

B4.name: cross_machine_transfer
B4.submission: One unchanged DesignSpec hash, at least two machine profile IDs, design_changed=false, and a short adapter rationale.

B5.name: novel_expression
B5.submission: A valid DesignSpec whose semantic distinctions remain measurable rather than purely rhetorical.

D.name: mcp_repair
D.access: brief plus WEFT MCP plus one repair round

policy: MCP V1 scores only mechanically evidenced dimensions.
Semantic quality requires blind human review.
Physical quality requires a printed and measured specimen.
A failed safety gate can never receive printable status regardless of total score.
